summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Corgi South Korea 2x Daily ETF (KRWX) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund aims to provide 2x leveraged exposure to the daily price movement of the iShares MSCI South Korea ETF (NYSE Arca: EWY), which tracks a market cap-weighted index of large- and mid-cap Korean firms. KRWX was launched on Jun 3, 2026 and is issued by Corgi.
